### Token Set up and DB connection

```{r}
con_bq <- dbConnect(

```

```{r}
# load BigQuery tables
icu <- tbl(con_bq, "icustays")
patients <- tbl(con_bq, "patients")
diagnosis <- tbl(con_bq, "diagnoses_icd")
d_diagnosis <- tbl(con_bq, "d_icd_diagnoses")
```

### Cohort and Charlson Comorbidity Creation with Gender Statistics
```{r}
micu_patients <- icu |>
  filter(first_careunit == "Medical Intensive Care Unit (MICU)") |>
  group_by(subject_id) |>
  slice_min(order_by = intime, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  inner_join(patients, by = "subject_id") |>
  filter(
    anchor_age >= 18, # Restrict analysis to adult patients
    !is.na(anchor_age), # Remove records with missing age
    !is.na(gender) # Remove records with missing gender
  ) |>
  mutate(
    days_death = sql("DATE_DIFF(CAST(dod AS DATE), CAST(intime AS DATE), DAY)"),
    mortality_30_days = ifelse(!is.na(dod) & days_death <= 30, 1, 0)
  )

micu_patients_local <- micu_patients |> collect()

diagnosis_subset <- diagnosis |>
  semi_join(micu_patients, by = "hadm_id") |>
  select(hadm_id, icd_code, icd_version) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
icd9_subset <- diagnosis_subset |> filter(icd_version == 9)
icd10_subset <- diagnosis_subset |> filter(icd_version == 10)

cci_icd9 <- comorbidity(
  x = icd9_subset,
  id = "hadm_id",
  code = "icd_code",
  map = "charlson_icd9_quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

cci_icd10 <- comorbidity(
  x = icd10_subset,
  id = "hadm_id",
  code = "icd_code",
  map = "charlson_icd10_quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

cci_icd9$charlson_score <- score(
  cci_icd9,
  weights = "quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

cci_icd10$charlson_score <- score(
  cci_icd10,
  weights = "quan",
  assign0 = FALSE
)

# Merge ICD-9 and ICD-10 Charlson scores, keeping the highest per admission
charlson_combined <- bind_rows(
  cci_icd9 |> select(hadm_id, charlson_score),
  cci_icd10 |> select(hadm_id, charlson_score)
) |>
  group_by(hadm_id) |>
  summarise(charlson_score = max(charlson_score), .groups = "drop")

micu_cohort_final <- micu_patients_local |>
  left_join(charlson_combined, by = "hadm_id") |>
  mutate(charlson_score = replace_na(charlson_score, 0))
```

### Gender-Specific Cohort Counts and 30-Day Mortality Rates After Initial MICU Admission
```{r}
gender_summary <- micu_cohort_final |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  summarise(
    total_patients = n(),
    mortality_rate = mean(mortality_30_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect()

male_group <- micu_cohort_final |>
  filter(gender == "M")

female_group <- micu_cohort_final |>
  filter(gender == "F")

male_summary <- gender_summary |> filter(gender == "M")
female_summary <- gender_summary |> filter(gender == "F")

print(female_summary)
print(male_summary)
```
### Vital Sign Feature Extraction
```{r}
# Pull first-24-hour vital signs recorded during the initial MICU stay
vital_codes <- c(
  220045, # Heart rate
  220210, # Respiratory rate
  220277, # SpO2
  223761, # Temperature Fahrenheit
  220052, # Mean arterial pressure
  220179, # Non-invasive systolic BP
  220180, # Non-invasive diastolic BP
  220181, # Non-invasive mean BP
  226512 # Admission weight (kg)
)

vital_data_query <- tbl(con_bq, "chartevents") |>
  filter(itemid %in% vital_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  filter(charttime >= intime) |>
  filter(charttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  mutate(
    vital_name = case_when(
      itemid == 220045 ~ "HR",
      itemid == 220210 ~ "RR",
      itemid == 220277 ~ "SpO2",
      itemid == 223761 ~ "Temp_F",
      itemid == 220052 ~ "Arterial_BP_Mean",
      itemid == 220179 ~ "NIBP_Systolic",
      itemid == 220180 ~ "NIBP_Diastolic",
      itemid == 220181 ~ "NIBP_Mean",
      itemid == 226512 ~ "Weight_kg"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(stay_id, vital_name) |>
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(valuenum, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

vital_data_local <- vital_data_query |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = vital_name,
    values_from = mean_value,
    names_glue = "{vital_name}_{.value}"
  )

micu_cohort_final <- micu_cohort_final |>
  left_join(vital_data_local, by = "stay_id")
```

### Laboratory Values Feature Extraction
```{r}
# Extract first-24-hour laboratory values from the initial MICU admission
lab_codes <- c(
  50813, # Lactate
  50912, # Creatinine
  51300, # WBC Count
  50809, # Glucose
  50983, # Sodium
  50971, # Potassium
  50902, # Chloride
  50882, # Bicarbonate
  51006, # Blood Urea Nitrogen
  51222, # Hemoglobin
  51221, # Hematocrit
  51265 # Platelets
)

lab_data_query <- tbl(con_bq, "labevents") |>
  filter(itemid %in% lab_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id, intime),
    by = c("subject_id", "hadm_id")
  ) |>
  filter(charttime >= intime) |>
  filter(charttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  mutate(
    lab_name = case_when(
      itemid == 50813 ~ "Lactate",
      itemid == 50912 ~ "Creatinine",
      itemid == 51300 ~ "WBC_Count",
      itemid == 50809 ~ "Glucose",
      itemid == 50983 ~ "Sodium",
      itemid == 50971 ~ "Potassium",
      itemid == 50902 ~ "Chloride",
      itemid == 50882 ~ "Bicarbonate",
      itemid == 51006 ~ "BUN",
      itemid == 51222 ~ "Hemoglobin",
      itemid == 51221 ~ "Hematocrit",
      itemid == 51265 ~ "Platelets"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(stay_id, lab_name) |>
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(valuenum, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lab_data_local <- lab_data_query |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = lab_name,
    values_from = mean_value,
    names_glue = "{lab_name}_{.value}"
  )

micu_cohort_final <- micu_cohort_final |>
  left_join(lab_data_local, by = "stay_id")
```

### Vasopressor Use and Intubation Features Extraction
```{r}
vasopressor_codes <- c(
  221906, # Norepinephrine
  221289, # Epinephrine
  221749, # Phenylephrine
  222315, # Vasopressin
  221662 # Dopamine
)

intubation_codes <- c(
  224385 # Intubation
)

input_events <- tbl(con_bq, "inputevents")
procedure_events <- tbl(con_bq, "procedureevents")

vasopressor_query <- input_events |>
  filter(itemid %in% vasopressor_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  # Restrict medications to the first 24 hours after ICU admission
  filter(starttime >= intime) |>
  filter(starttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  group_by(stay_id) |>
  summarise(vaso_active = 1, .groups = "drop")

intubation_data_query <- procedure_events |>
  filter(itemid %in% intubation_codes) |>
  inner_join(
    micu_patients |> select(stay_id, intime),
    by = "stay_id"
  ) |>
  # Restrict procedures to the first 24 hours after ICU admission
  filter(starttime >= intime) |>
  filter(starttime <= sql("DATETIME_ADD(intime, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)")) |>
  group_by(stay_id) |>
  summarise(intubated = 1, .groups = "drop")

vasopressor_local <- vasopressor_query |> collect()
intubation_local <- intubation_data_query |> collect()

micu_cohort_final <- micu_cohort_final |>
  left_join(vasopressor_local, by = "stay_id") |>
  left_join(intubation_local, by = "stay_id") |>
  mutate(
    vaso_active = replace_na(vaso_active, 0),
    intubated = replace_na(intubated, 0)
  )
```
